name: Argentina
sources: GDP $141.4bn and 32.8m people (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.CD and SP.POP.TOTL, 1990; the exact prints are $141.353bn and 32,755,901). Output had fallen about 6% in 1989 and fell again in 1990; the decade to 1990 is the lost decade, hence a negative TFP trend of -0.8%/yr.

INFLATION IS NOT THE TRANSCRIBED PRINT. The real 1990 figure is INDEC CPI of 2314% for the year, following 3080% in 1989 — Argentina had two hyperinflationary bursts, February-July 1989 and December 1989-March 1990, and the game opens inside the second one. On the fraction-of-1 convention that is 23.14, nearly eight times the 3.0 ceiling economy.rs clamps to on the first tick, so the file ships 2.950 and records the truth here. This is the same treatment Brazil, Poland and Yugoslavia already get, and it is a decimal stand-in rather than a designed damping: see brazil.json for the measured cost of that choice.

interest_rate 2.9 is likewise a stand-in. Nominal rates in the Bonex-plan weeks of January 1990 ran with inflation, in the thousands of percent; the coupling rule in the schema (real rate within 0.5 of neutral) forbids entering them beside a clamped inflation figure. The Convertibility Plan of April 1991 that ends this is not scripted — the sim's central bank has to find it.

Tax take 16% of GDP: federal revenue had collapsed with the Olivera-Tanzi effect, the state financing itself by the inflation tax. Public investment 4% and private 10% against gross fixed capital formation of about 14% of GDP, the lowest of the century.

Debt 0.45: external debt $62.2bn at end-1990 (World Bank Global Development Finance), about 44% of GDP, overwhelmingly public and in arrears since the 1988 suspension. The Brady deal is still three years away.
Oil 0.48 mbd: YPF and the associated private producers pumped about 483,000 bbl/d in 1990 (Secretaria de Energia), roughly self-sufficiency. Privatisation of YPF begins in 1991.

Defence 1.6% of GDP: the armed forces were cut hard after the Falklands and after the 1987-88 carapintada mutinies. Strength 11 reflects a conscript army with no ability to project, and Menem's pardons of the junta in October 1989 and December 1990.

Stability 36: the second hyperinflation, the Bonex plan confiscating time deposits in January 1990, and the fourth and last carapintada rising on 3 December 1990. Separatism 0.02 — Argentina has essentially none.

pop_growth_1990 = 1.5630%/yr. Compound annual growth of World Bank SP.POP.TOTL, series ARG (Argentina): 29,863,093 in 1984 to 32,270,948 in 1989 — the five years ending on the eve of the 1 January 1990 start date. See EconomyRecord::pop_growth_1990 in spheres-sim/src/data/mod.rs for why the window ends in 1989 and not with the single-year 1990 rate.

note: 1990 TECHNOLOGY: AUTHORED, NOT DERIVED. What this nation knew on 1 January 1990 is transcribed and sourced grant by grant, exactly like every other 1990 figure in this file, and is not read off tfp_trend - there was never a code path from the trend to the known set, and the zero that stood there was a claim about the world rather than an absence of one (BIBLE section 8 and iron rule 4, both amended 2026-08-30). THE PREDICATE IS SPLIT, and split by the technology's OWN EFFECT TYPE so that it is mechanically computable and never a per-nation judgement call. A node whose effects include MilitaryEfficiency, MilitaryStrength, DiffusionEmission or CostReduction is SOVEREIGNTY-SIDE: holding it means this nation could PRODUCE it, so operating an imported article does not qualify. Every other node is USE-SIDE: deployed and in operational use here is enough, whoever built it, because the effect such a node pays is a productivity, health or output effect and that effect is real in the country where the machine runs. Of the 48 technologies the tree lets anyone hold in 1990, 17 are sovereignty-side and 31 are use-side.

ALL 48 OF THE 1990-ELIGIBLE TECHNOLOGIES WERE RULED FOR THIS NATION, one at a time, against a standard published per technology rather than per country. 3 were held and are listed below with their citations; 45 were refused. The refused ids are named at the end of this note so that a reader can tell a cell that was examined and refused from a cell nobody looked at - those are different claims and the schema would otherwise flatten them into the same silence.

RULED AND REFUSED, ids only (the reasoning for each refusal is held with the board that wrote it, one standard per technology): core_cmos_submicron, core_packet_internetworking, core_single_mode_fiber, core_carbon_composites, core_combined_cycle_turbine, core_pcr, comp_microprocessor, comp_risc_superscalar, comp_relational_database, comm_fibre_optic_backbone, comm_geostationary_comsat, ener_seismic_3d_imaging, ener_horizontal_drilling, ener_gas_turbine_combined_cycle, ener_crystalline_silicon_module, matl_semiconductor_lithography, matl_composite_structures, matl_industrial_robotics, matl_lean_production, matl_single_crystal_superalloy, matl_rare_earth_magnet, matl_stereolithography, aero_precision_munitions, aero_pulse_doppler_radar, aero_stealth_shaping, aero_quiet_submarine, aero_recon_satellite, bio_recombinant_pharma, bio_oral_rehydration, bio_cross_sectional_imaging, bio_conjugate_vaccine, bio_monoclonal_antibody, bio_automated_sequencing, tran_container_intermodal, tran_post_panamax_ship, tran_electronic_freight_documents, tran_high_speed_rail, agri_drip_irrigation, agri_composite_membrane, agri_conservation_tillage, agri_integrated_pest_management, agri_protected_cultivation, agri_tissue_culture_propagation, agri_marine_aquaculture, agri_flue_gas_desulphurisation.

granted.source: R3: Movicom, a Socma/BellSouth joint venture, opened Argentina's first mobile telephone service in the Buenos Aires metropolitan area on 1 November 1989 on the AMPS standard, and had 12,000 subscribers a year later - matching the World Bank WDI IT.CEL.SETS figure of 12,000 for Argentina in 1990 exactly.

Movicom, a Socma (Grupo Macri)/BellSouth joint venture, began Argentina's first mobile telephone service in the Buenos Aires metropolitan area on 1 November 1989 on AMPS, and reached 12,000 subscribers within a year - matching the World Bank WDI IT.CEL.SETS 1990 figure of 12,000 exactly. It held a monopoly until Miniphone in 1993.
WHO/UNICEF WUENIC DTP3 coverage, Argentina, 1990: 87%. Series: WUENIC DTP3 ('Argentina,ARG,1990,87').
